item.title: Ledger 2026-11-09: #590 #604 #607 #622 #623
item.body:
Refs #620

First steward batch of the ledger (rule #620): GAP and CHANGELOG-LEGACY entries from the bodies of the merged PRs #590, #604, #607, #622 and #623, written by `tooling/docs/ledger.py` (#621). The PR touches only the two ledger files, so no macOS jobs run.

**Before this batch:**
- #590's prose blocks were rewritten in the column-keyed format.
- The GAP-148 `SwiftHFR final` texts of #622 and #623 were merged into #623's block (the earlier merge).

**Mechanical check (AGENTS.md §8, no adversarial review):** on base `53170bbad5b278f30c7ebfe224497d347e66554e`, run
`python3 tooling/docs/ledger.py fold --apply --prs 590,604,607,622,623`, then `git diff --exit-code <head>`. The diff must be empty.

**Left BY HAND:** #590's `ledger-note` (the H.1 decision 2 sentence) goes in a separate reviewed PR.

**After merge:** `python3 tooling/docs/ledger.py done 590 604 607 622 623 --apply`.

Direct-PR: steward ledger batch (#620 process, no issue of its own)
